svg.title: Separate link, session and clock diagnostics
svg.desc: The user interface reports physical link, admitted session and conversion-clock state separately. Local output protection acts independently of status delivery. Engineering counters explain faults without hiding an unsupported format behind a link indicator.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
